TransMap studies distal genetic effects at the level of individual genes,
local co-expression programs, and global genetically coordinated programs.

This development vignette documents the package layout. Executable examples
will be added alongside the validated analysis functions and example data.
Manuscript figure notebooks and data manifests are maintained separately in
[`transmap_manuscript`](https://github.com/xueweic/transmap_manuscript).
